review_description: Quoting was great.Staff very kind polite and hard working. Tidy,  punctual.Awesome experience, very happy

I  do not say they are simply the best lightly.  When I was first in the market for a battery and I contacted Louis, and he came around to scope the installation.  However there was a high level of confusion about whether the NSW rebate scheme was to run in addition to the Commonwealth scheme.  Louis advised me not to go ahead till we both had a clearer picture of the implications.  This was sage advice as the NSW scheme was stopped and the install was going to cost more. It is significant that at no time did Louis put me under any pressure whatsoever to sign up.  I recalculated and felt that it still made financial sense.  When I advised Louis of my decision. He gave me an install date and as agreed at 7am his team arrived and worked solidly to get the battery in.  The team were efficient effective and cleaned and tidied up after themselves, despite the fact that it was getting dark and lightly drizzling.  When they left I had both a running battery and a fair understanding of how to utilise the app.  Since then, Louis has come back to make sure we were happy and he has made a couple of tweaks to the install to improve it.  To have a tradie who is more interested in ensuring that his customers are satisfied rather than just grabbing the cash and disappearing is like a breath of fresh air.  The battery is working perfectly and is providing savings already, and the blackout change over is instantaneous.It is for these reasons I think Louis and Sinclair Renewable Energy are simply the best!I would rate the battery as 5/5 and the inverter as 5/5.   The installation even more.

Informative and a truly genuine guy, very helpful when working out what our solar needs were and great communication, quote was 1/2 price to other companies for exactly the same thing. The guys were prompt and tidy on site, we highly recommend Louis and his team...extremely professional.
Everything from the original contact to the sales/quoting process and through to the installation was personable, professional and efficient. Highly recommend.
Really enjoyed working with Louis.  He was prompt, took us through options, turnaround was fast and the installation was done to a high standard.

As a local supplier, Sinclair provides best value for money offer without sacrificing quality of work. I was only looking for solar battery at first but with savings, it gave me flexibility to add more solar panels.The service was awesome and with well explained set up and monitoring system.

The entire process from initial contact, quoting, on-site visit, installation and post install was outstanding. Louis was very open and honest. He was not focused on pushing a particular solution but was also very clear in making comparisons between potential options. Loius and his team completed a large install in one day working well beyond normal business hours. At short notice they adapted the proposed layout and I am exceptionally happy with the result.  Louis even stayed after the installation to run through everything. Highly highly recommended.
Professional at every level; at site visit stage, at quotation stage, at installation and at handover. I could not recommend more highly.

Louis from SRE was super helpful from the get go. He was able to come out for a quote asap and happy to oblige myself with explaining everything in simple terms. We’d struggled previously to get solar companies to move forward with quotes due to having significant shade from nearby trees on our property. Louis was upfront about the challenges, provided conservative projections in our quote, and avoided upselling us for all the trimmings for shade solutions.Super happy with his communication, the job was done well & really quickly, less than 2 weeks after accepting the quote and Louis has been helpful with after sales support with our monitoring system.Would recommend the team at SRE if you’re looking for a straightforward, trustworthy solar company.

It took us a long time to get into the solar scene and along the way we spoke to a range of suppliers with various bits of information, some good, some patronising and some just a sales push for top $.In the end we chose Sinclair Renewable Energy because of comparable value in our quote, quality of product, ease of communication, being a local business and after sales / product back up.When we had the system installed, a team of four installers were here. They were fantastic. They checked in with us during the install and were easy to deal with. They got on with the job as pure professionals.We were shown how to use the related app and are now having fun tracking our usage.
Louis has been great to work with, providing good advice for my setup, clear in his communication and clean installation.

Quote provided via onsite visit by Louis Sinclair was both prompt & thorough.Install was painless & tradesman left sight tidy etc.Overall quality of instal & price were great.Would highly recommend Sinclair Renewable Energy.13.2kw solar - 10kw inverter - 9.6kw batteryRegardsRod

Our Neighbour used Sinclair Renewable Energy (SRE) and had nothing but praise for them.Sales / quoting was very easy as initially SRE were able to use the internet to see our property before coming out for an on-site inspection and consultation.Louis was extremely easy to work with and very prompt with supplying information.SRE was able to deal with our energy provider to get everything sorted with our grid connection.With the new solar battery rebate, Louis was willing and able to do a split install so that we had our panels up and working for us before coming back to install our battery so we got the most out of the available rebates.We are yet to move fully however Louis is coming back to show/help us with setting up the monitoring software.Pricing, SRE came in well below other competitors that we got quotes from, with one competitor being $15k more for a similar system.Highly recommend using SRE

The initial meeting with Louis Sinclair was great. He was very knowledgeable, straightforward, and he answered all of my questions. I had a quote very promptly after our meeting and it was very competitive compared to other quotes for the exact same system. Louis was very easy to contact and work with prior to the installation, and Leroy and the crew that did the install on the day were very friendly and organised. They did an awesome job, and explained the inverter, helped me get set up on the app, so I could see straight away what my panels were doing, and answered all of my questions. After everything was done, they did a great job of leaving my front yard clean and tidy. Within an hour of the crew leaving, Louis was in contact with me to touch base and see how I was feeling about the crew and the job, and to find out if I had any other questions, and he even did a firmware upgrade as we spoke. All-in-all, a very easy and positive experience. I am extremely happy with my new solar panels. I can't recommend Sinclair Renewable Energy enough!

Louis was very knowledgeable and explained the whole process from quoting to installing the solar system. There was no pushy sales pitches which was appreciated.At all times Louis was professional and communicative. He delivered on his promises again with timeframes of when to receive the quotes to installation.We couldn’t recommend his business and work ethic highly enough.

After making an online enquiry I was bombarded by solar companies quoting me any number of different solar packages. Thankfully I found Louis Sinclair who took the time to visit with me and explain the differences in the various quotes and design the best system for our property. The install team did a great job removing the old panels and replacing with the new system. After the install, Louis took the time to come back and show me how everything works and help me set timers on pool pump, etc... to work when solar at its optimum. Highly recommend Louis and the team at Sinclair Renewable Energy.

After 3 years of research and multiple quotes I finally decided a Solar Panel System was a worthwhile investment.My research also involved installer’s; I needed to feel I was getting the right advice in respect of the product, its quality and its suitability for my circumstances. Also I needed to feel confident that the installer would respond promptly to any queries I may have.After meeting Louis Sinclair of Sinclair Renewable Energy I felt confident to place an order. Louis enthusiasm for Solar and his product knowledge is impressive and I was happy with his quote.His promise of a prompt and quality fitting was fulfilled and the system was up and running efficiently within three weeks of the quote.I have no hesitation in recommending Sinclair Renewable Energy due to this very sound experience.David.

Louis went above and beyond to advise and quote on my solar panels, car charger, smart inverter and battery.   His installation team were fabulous and it was all completed without a hitch.  A very respectful, efficient and professional team.Louis helped set up my software and arranged all grid connections and is on tap if I need him.A perfect experience from a very happy customer.I highly recommend Louis and would trust him totally to give you the best set up for your situation.
The sales and quoting process was straightforward. Panell installers broke 5 tiles but the rest of the installation went well. Louis went the extra mile during ser up truly grateful.

Louis was prompt in quoting and installing after a site visit to advise our options. Despite the inclement weather, the installation was on time. The job was done in a very friendly and polite fashion. Everything was tidy and Louis made sure that everything was working well. He also gave a lot of advice on the use of the new system on our power plan.

(Deposit paid at this stage ) Louis Sinclair has been so on the job ,Site inspection ,Walked the roof,Checked meter box Identified problems on roof and the meter box ,wiring from grid needs to be upgraded ,these problems otherwise would be found install day by others quoting on Google roof tops. We then decided on size to be quoted.Wiring upgrade & repairs are in the hands of level 2 electrician when completed install date will be decided on, (The install is 8 kw system with catch power green diverter)

Louis was the only installer to come to the property to see my set up before quoting. Louis kept me informed of how the installation was going to go, he was on time for the initial set up and was here until he had completed the job, tidying up as he went. The installation team for the panels came as directed but were hampered by weather in finishing on the prescribed day. To their credit they were back the next working day to finish off the panel installation. Louis completed his side of the installation and completed all paperwork and ran me through the set up and potential shutdown/re-instate procedure. You can't go wrong using Sinclair Renewable Energy, thanks Louis.

Louis able to design and quote for a system achieved what we wanted to do while also minimising any constraints and adverse effects imposed by the limitations of the site. Lockie and the others in Louis' installation team were very good to interact with and cleaned up when they had finished. Louis did a great job installing and commissioning the battery.All the required documentation has been taken car of by Louis and his team at Sinclair RE and we haven't had to do any of that sort of stuff.
Louis was great to deal with. Friendly, helpful and kept me up to date with the install. The team was friendly during the install.
Louis was fantastic from the start. He knew his stuff, and had answers to our questions. All went really well and we are very happy with the end result.

I contacted Louis from Sinclair Renewables after the recommendation from Solarquotes. From contact to install the work was completed to an excellent standard, as I myself have an electrical background.When the install was complete, Louis talked me through the Tesla app set up process which was very intuitive  and as I already own a Tesla Model 3 I was already familiar with the app so it made the process even easier.Finally I can recommend Louis very highly as his work ethic and dedication to same are faultless.Battery rating: 5/5

Couldnt have asked for better service. All questions were answered and changes I asked for incorporated with no quibbles. Installers were a great bunch of guys.Had issues with my electricity supplier. Meter box was full so solar fuses could not be fitted. Need to have the fuses and meter fitted in one go. Contractor used by electricity supplier is not licensed to install fuses and they dont get it that the solar installers contractor can do all this once the electricity supplier gives the go ahead.Once the smart meter and solar fuses are installed I am going to look for another electricity supplier as these guys (Globird) are very very hard to get hold of and just dont understand despite me phoning and sending numerous emails.Louis from Sinclair has been helping me along the way but the issue is with the electricity supplier not understanding what is required.

The whole process from initial contact to installation was very professional and courteous. Couldn’t fault the installation with the team happy to answer questions and help with the app. Everything was seamless as they handled the grid connection and did a follow up call to see how it all went.

Louis and his team at Sinclair Renewable Energy were fantastic to work with throughout the process. I obtained 3 x quotes and decided to go with Sinclair Renewable Energy because they had some really good reviews, but more importantly they were local to my area. They followed through in answering all my questions and were happy to advise on alternatives. Once I decided to go with them it wasn’t a long wait for install. As I said the install team were local to the area and very trustworthy and very particular in their work. I can highly recommend Sinclair Renewable Energy.

From initial enquiry  through to solar system install, Louis from Sinclair Renewable Energy was fantastic to work with. Louis provided very sound and honest advice on the best system to suit my current power needs and also to provide a level of future proofing. I have no hesitation in recommending Sinclair Energy to anyone from the Newcastle greater area who are looking at quality solar for their house or business and are looking for a professional solar electrician local based company to deal with and want to avoid pushy solar sales people that are purely selling a cheap product for a quick profit.
Louis did a great job of designing a system for my needs. Installation was faultless. Grid connection covered and follow up serviceExcellent.

From start to finish, Louis and the installation team exceeded my expectations in every way. The solar panels were flawlessly installed, and the attention to detail was impressive. The installers were punctual, courteous, and highly professional. They treated my property with care and left everything tidy. Overall, I couldn’t be happier with my solar installation, AND the price!

Louis came out incredibly quickly, gave me a number of options and price points as well as explaining the whole process really well. There was no sales pressure, just honest advice.The installation went a lot faster than expected and the team young guys that came out were efficient and polite and were also happy to explain the process as they went. Everything was clean and tidy after they had finished.Louis organised everything from start to finish and advised my supplier of the connection.I couldn't be happier, the system looks great and is functioning better than I expected.

Excellent, professional and friendly service. From quote to install Louis and the team answered any questions I had and provided any information I asked for. Installers arrived when they said they would and were very friendly and polite. The installation is neat and professional and I am impressed by the quality and attention to detail. I also had a Catch Power Green Power hot water diverter installed at the same time which meant that the meter panel was full. Sinclair Energy then worked with my power retailer to arrange for the solar fuses and meter upgrades to all be done at the same time without me needing to do anything, which was great. Would recommend Sinclair Renewable Energy.

I started to shop around for quotes in December. The first thing that struck me was how hard it was to find an installer that would actually come out and look at the site. I think it was 3 installers that I had to submit a form online and then they just sent a quote, not even what I was asking for. Another one who did come out quoted but didn't really listen to my needs and didn't include everything in the quote to make it look better.I wanted panels, a battery and an EV charger.Louis came and saw me and listened to me. Found out not only my needs but my motivation and asked questions. Although I wanted an EV charger, Louis was the only one who actually asked me what type of EV I had.All the rain we had held up the installation of the panels but Louis made the panel installation easier by installing the battery and inverter in the garage before the panels could go up. The process was seamless and was up and running in no time.I am stoked in the system and service that Louis and his team delivered. I would highly recommend Sinclair Renewable energy.

Louis from Solar Renewable Energy led us through the process of solar installation and we have no problems in recommending him to any and all that ask. Louis is qualified to carry out all of the activities involved so that there are no subbies. He was quick to respond to our request for a quote and listened to our needs for a 3 phase system before assessing our location and recommending several quality options at differing price points to meet those needs. The systems he has put in place for communication and formalising the quotation and invoicing made life extremely easy and quick. The installation was quick, thorough and looks great on the roof and after commissioning, its use and monitoring was fully explained as well as organising the change over of meters to get payed for feed in power. At no time was rubbish left laying around our home. Louis has proved himself to be professional, trustworthy and polite throughout our journey into solar energy.

I have an 11yr old system which needed the inverter replaced.  I was told by larger firms that due to the age of the system I need to replace the whole system at a cost of $6k-$9k.Louis was friendly and informative & was able to upgrade my inverter to a 5kw for a very reasonable price.He was on time, very knowledgeable and great to deal with.Highly recommend.

I would highly recommend Sinclair Renewable for solar. Louis was fantastic, answered our many, many questions without any problems and welcomed more! He clearly explained the process, costs, and gave us several options for our situation. He helped upgrade our meter box to three phase and dealt with our electricity company on our behalf which was greatly appreciated. His team were fantastic on installation day, everyone was polite and tidy.

Louis and his team of installers were very polite and well trained in their specific roles right from the start. They were knowledgeable and willing to explain any questions I had regarding my system and installation process. Job was done in approximately 4.5 hours.I personally preferred a local company that was well established but not too big to forget how to treat customers with old fashioned service and respect.I’m extremely happy with my system thus far.

I highly recommend Sinclair Renewable Energy after having our system installed.Of all the quotes we received, Louis was the only one who was took time to understand what we were looking for and not just try and sell us the most expensive system. He provided quotes and information about 4 different setups to make sure we could choose the right system. I cannot be happier with the install of our system and the service provided by Louis.

I recently engaged Sinclair Renewable Energy for the installation of a 13.2kW solar system on my property, and my experience with the company has been exceptional across various aspects.The installation team exhibited a high level of professionalism and efficiency throughout the process. They adhered to the proposed timeline and demonstrated a meticulous approach to their work. The positive attitude of the team members contributed to a seamless installation experience.Business owner Louis showcased an impressive depth of knowledge in the field of solar energy. What particularly stood out was his ability to convey complex technical information in an accessible manner. He provided comprehensive insights into the system, breaking down intricate details into manageable components, which greatly aided in my decision-making process.The overall execution of the project, from the installation team's proficiency to Louis's expertise, reflects positively on Sinclair Renewable Energy. Based on my experience, I would recommend them for their professionalism, technical proficiency, and commitment to client education. The successful installation of the solar system aligns with the company's reputation for delivering reliable renewable energy solutions.
Louis was fantastic to deal with. Very knowledgeable and not a pushy salesman.Quote and installation was seamless and very happy with my system.I would definitely recommend Sinclair Renewable Energy.
Louis and his team were exceptional, everything was organised & panels were installed & after sales service was excellent also. I would have no hesitation in recommending this business to others.
Excellent service from start to finish.  Very knowledgeable, helpful and professional and on time with the installation. Thanks very much would definitely recommend.

We couldn't fault Sinclair Energy's efficiency and install team. Being quoted by the tradesman who installs the systems meant a different perspective and more thorough examination of our home and what we were likely to need, leaving no surprises and nothing to chance.Everything was on time exactly as promised every step of the way, and the installers were polite and tidy, leaving nothing behind. Our questions were answered with patience and they were happy to explain the process along the way.Louis Sinclair has a thorough understanding and knowledge of the system he installs, and has ensured we know he is available for help and advice at any time. He also helped us with organising our power company to do their bit.We wouldn't hesitate to use Sinclair Energy in the future, and would absolutely recommend them as a quality installer.

We have read all previous reviews and I have no hesitation in concurring with them all. We followed the steps recommended by Solar Quotes and once Louis was chosen the whole process was smooth sailing.. Going solar is a big decision financially. You need to be confident in the installer as this is an area new to most of us. There are glossy ads on TV with great "packages" but to engage with an independent local company is the most sensible way to go. You are in very safe hands with Louis from on site inspections to after sale service .

I contacted Louis from Sinclair Renewables after the recommendation from Solarquotes. He quickly came over to have a look and discuss my options. He clearly explained some of the issues I was going to have due to the dimensions of my property but came up with the perfect solution to get two powerwalls fitted neatly. The install was completed to a very good standard in a timely manner which was even commented on by another electrician who we had over to do something else. If a competitor tells you it's good, you know it's good! Once the install was complete, Louis talked me through the Tesla app set up process which was very intuitive and he even followed up with a phone call 24 hours later to make sure everything was still going ok.

From the very start Sinclair Renewable Energy stood out as the company of choice for our solar batteries. Out of the numerous companies we requested quotes from, Louis was the only one who came to the house to review our current solar system and ask what we wanted to achieve from our battery storage. He helped design a system tailored to what we wanted. All other companies contacted were either pushy sales reps, or just wouldn’t listen to what we were trying to achieve.The finished product was installed to a very high tradesman like manner and we couldn’t be more happy with the whole process from start to finish.Highly recommend calling Sinclair Renewable Energy for any solar requirements around the Newcastle and Hunter region.

Louis inspired confidence right from the first phone call. There were several others I was looking at, nothing against them, but he just stood out. He presented all Solar/battery scenarios for us to consider with clarity, affable enthusiasm and considerable technical knowledge and that inspired confidence in me to choose him.He's a man who enjoys what he does for a living and I enjoyed him `geeking' out over the system we ended up choosing. I've friends and family who are considering solar/battery systems and I've been recommending Louis as the man to go to - truly, he's that good.I had discussions with him about the pro's and cons of each system and they were presented to me online in an attractive and easy to understand manner. Then, once the decision was made, we were up and going within a very short time frame. He got in and did the work quickly, and with skillful knowledge and care.We saved up for the type of quality system we wanted - effectively off-grid but still connected. And so far, this past couple of weeks, that's been the case - it's so good to be running our household purely from the energy from the sun.Louis will be back soon to install the car charger for the Batmobile, err, EV I've decided to order so I'm excited to be free from fossil fuels of all types very soon and `fangin' about Port Stephens on sun juice.Thanks Louis

From the very get go Louis was outstanding. We got 7 businesses to quote on our Solar system as we were not only looking for a Solar System, but also some guidance, Louis was happy to discuss our concerns and stepped us through the alternatives and he was prepared to offer advice as to what he thought would be best for us, even if he was not chosen. He was extremely professional and well set up and executed the installation without a hiccup and the double glass panels look amazing.If you are looking for a Solar Installer who cares, Louis is your man

We are extremely happy with our solar system! Louis went above and beyond for us. From helping us to decide on the size of the system to cater to our needs, to the installation, and following up with us afterwards to ensure the system was performing as expected. His passion for solar showed through all of our dealings with him and his professionalism and attention to detail is second to none. Louis kept us in the loop and updated through the entire process. We couldn’t recommend him enough! Very happy clients, thanks again Louis!

From the first phone conversation and onsite meeting we were convinced that Sinclair Renewable Energy would be our choice.The timing from acceptance of quote to installation was awesome. Producing solar within hours from morning of install.Louis explained everything and answered any questions we had before and after install.Fast, Efficient, professional and super friendly.Excellent customer service would recommend this Family Business every time.Thankyou Louis.

Louis came to my house and did not try to do a hard sell to me. He went through through the process in simple to understand terms and I could tell straight away he was invested in solar energy. He was open to all questions and his knowledge and promise of ongoing support won me over rather than the sales pitches from the big players.I had a number of questions to ask following the quotation meeting and these were all answered promptly and honestly.The installation was professionally completed and the boys were happy and respectful. Following the installation Louis contacted me to check that everything went well. He then gave me details of a great electricity provider to get the best from my new system.I highly recommend this company for anyone looking at installing solar!

Everything about Sinclair Renewable Energy is top notch. From the initial quotes to the final commission was done at a very professional and friendly level. Out of the 3 companies we received quotes from they were the only ones to come out and inspect the job. They did everything promptly and to a high standard. Customer service could not be better.Very highly recommended.

Having had experience with a solar installation at a previous home  where I  successfully used SolarQuotes  for  introductions I was able to deal with  Louis by telephone. HIs service was excellent and he was competitive with price. My selection was to get a local hands on supplier  (Electrician not salesperson) and I also  wanted to give the business to a genuine small business.  From the start and through the whole process Louis came across as genuine and confident and came out and inspected the site before giving recommendations. His  pricing was not the cheapest nor the dearest but I was able to confirm that he was recommending the most suitable panels and inverter for my holiday home needs. There was no pressure sales pitch or and he was able to do the job in a short time. He was on site all the time and did all the electrical  work  personally  and supervised  his assistants on the roof we  Being there himself also enabled  assurances  that the inverter was being installed in the most appropriate location. My initial thoughts were that he may have been stretched as a relatively young business but he convinced me that he has the right back up and his business knowledge is gaining momentum. HIs attitude as a small family business where the tradie does the job and gives good service was clearly evident and is appreciated. He followed up with answers where necessary but did not pester me He was more than polite and punctual and left the job  very tidy  and assisted on site with the most efficient way to get the necessary connection to the grid. I wish him well in his ongoing business and am pleased that I helped a young  genuine business noting that all businesses had to start  somewhere and the good ones flourish. Thanks Louis
Thanks for the professional and easy going approach with both your communication of the details and schedule of the works along with the final installation of our Tesla Battery system.

We received a prompt and detailed quote with a number of options to suit our needs.  The installation was done in a timely and efficient manner, punctual and polite service at all times with good communication skills demonstrated when asked questions about products and explaining the installation process.  They organised the grid connection after installation.  Highly recommended.

Our experience with Sinclair Renewable was great, from the first contact that we had with Louis right though to the end. We spent ages calling other companies and searching online for quotes only to be ignored or told to go with expensive systems that wont really suited to us, however with Sinclair Renewable it was different, once contact was made with louis he actaully came out to our house and sat down with us to go over what we wanted to achieve and what system was the best direction for us and why that was the case. The pricing was competative with other similar businesses. The customer service provided was 2nd to none. We signed the contract in Dec and Louis was very upfront about the timing of when install would occur, we were quoted late Feb. Louis was in constant communication during the wait, we were provided an install date of Mid Feburary. On the morning of the install, louis went over the plan with us, and allowed us to fine tune the panel layout to our requirements. The install went smoothly over a couple of days. The site was left clean with no rubish around. Following the install, i had a little issue with our retailer not finding the paperwork they needed, Louis was great and forwarded me the CCEW that was sent to them, allowing me to follow it up and sort it out quickly. Overall, we were very happy with the quality, service and products that were installed and we look forward to the benifits of our new solar system, supplied and installed by Sinclair Renewable Energy.
